List any details of the original omitted, added, or changed in EACH version: task, entity, numbers, persona, hobbies, research interests, constraints, certainty, options, scope. Even secondary persona omissions count as NOT equivalent. Do NOT approve merely because the main idea survived. Are A and B directly equivalent to one another? Do not favor formality. {"original": "give me 10 different and very interesting  short psychological story ideas for backrooms videos. an example that was really good is someone stuck in an infinite grocery store and then when they try to escape through the front door (it\u2019s locked), a big monster is released. make sure it makes sense for the main character to have a camera. try not to have more than the main character.\n", "A": "Please provide 10 distinct and compelling short psychological story concepts suitable for Backrooms-themed videos. Similar to the example of a protagonist trapped in an infinite grocery store encountering a creature at a locked exit, ensure each scenario provides a logical justification for the character carrying a camera. Please restrict the cast to the main character only.", "B": "Hey, could you come up with 10 unique and super interesting short psychological story ideas for Backrooms videos? Think like that one where someone's trapped in an endless grocery store and a monster pops out when they try the locked exit. Please make sure there's a logical reason for them to be filming and keep it to just the main character."}
